Coronation.heading: {=realms_coronation_heading}The Return of the King
Coronation.text: {=realms_coronation_text}Before the gate of Minas Tirith the Steward of Gondor offers up the white rod of his office, and the King gives it back to him. Then the ancient crown of the kings is set upon the head of {HERO}.{newline}After long years an heir of Isildur sits upon the throne of Gondor, and the {CLAN} rules the realm from {SEAT}.
